title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Murray Barnett, founder of 26West Sport, is a leading sports commercial executive, investor and industry commentator with over 30 years’ experience driving growth and unlocking value across global sport. His career includes senior leadership roles at ESPN, World Rugby and Formula 1, where he developed major commercial strategies, transformed revenue opportunities and secured landmark partnerships, including Formula 1’s Aramco agreement. An active investor in sports businesses, Murray is also a regular commentator on Unofficial Partner: The Bundle and Moneyball: The Business of Sport, offering expert perspectives on the deals, trends and innovations shaping the industry.

Through 26West Sport, Murray brings unrivalled commercial experience, strategic insight and an extensive global network to rights holders, brands, broadcasters and investors. Specialising in media rights, sponsorship, event commercialisation and strategic investment, 26West Sport combines ambitious thinking with proven dealmaking expertise to identify opportunities, maximise value and deliver tangible results. From strategy to execution, 26West Sport turns commercial ambition into commercial success.
Murray works with a group of industry leading experts who complement his knowledge of sports marketplace.
